answer: An agent marketplace grants each identity one job slot only after it locks 100 copper tokens for a 90-day horizon. The contract keeps the bond locked even if the agent quits, so the same funds cannot back new identities during that period. A violet badge marks bonded accounts. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous fake workers must therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens; splitting one wallet into many does not reduce that cost.
